title: Daughters of God
author: Gordon B. Hinckley
calling_raw: First Counselor in the First Presidency
notes_text: 1.  I am aware of Abigail Adams’s correspondence with John Adams on this point. However, it does not follow that all of the fifty-six signers of the Declaration were of the same view. Subsequent generations have regarded men in its generic sense. I might have used various other examples on which there could be no question.
